privacy: No author names, raw review texts, response texts, phone numbers, or customer identifiers copied. Matching used them transiently; audit stores row IDs, displayed date labels, and SHA-256 fingerprints only.
normalization_method: Unicode NFKC; lowercase; ё→е; punctuation/symbols to spaces; whitespace collapsed. Full normalized text equality is the exact-match test. Author/date checks are auxiliary and never expose author values.

confirmed_and_probable_dedup_preferred_w.basis: Deduplicate 104 metadata-supported exact overlaps and 23 manually checked likely text variants; retain 13 low-confidence/metadata-conflict UI rows as possible additional opinions.

strict_metadata_supported_exact_only.basis: Only 104 exact-text matches with date and author support are merged; all text variants and conflicts remain separate.

all_ui_items_overlap_sensitivity.basis: All 140 UI entries map to an existing Yandex Maps opinion, including unresolved candidates; lower bound only, not asserted as proven.

ui_review_audit_rows.match_basis: Manually checked high text similarity plus matching date and/or author; retained as a probable version match, not exact text.

confidence_caveats: Short exact texts are not treated as proven duplicates by text alone; rows 92 and 115 are matched to separate UI records only where normalized author and displayed day uniquely agree.
Text-variant matches are marked probable, not exact. 12 low-similarity same-platform candidates plus 1 exact-text metadata conflict are left unresolved; they are not forced into the deduped baseline.
UI date labels with no year are preserved as displayed; for the three Eda records, 2026 is inferred from current card context and flagged as inferred.
